sections.text: مقدمة

يوضح هذا المستند فحص المعدات I1، الذي يجب إجراؤه عليه 
القواعد الأسبوعية كما هو موضح بواسطة W1 في كتلة العنوان.

The IC697CMM742 Ethernet Interface provides
high performance TCP/IP communications for the 
C80-75 MFC.

The Ethernet Interface plugs into a single slot in
a C80-75 MFC rack and is configured with the MFC
برامج برمجة ويندوز. ما يصل إلى أربعة إيثرنت
يمكن تركيب وحدات الواجهة في C80-75
رف وحدة المعالجة المركزية MFC.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Tawfeeq, tested by 
eng. Bahaa Abd El-Wahab, revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, 
accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Elshreif, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan 
head sector of Nubaria power station .

This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC quality 
control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb 
quality control head sector.
Features

Connects C80-75 MFC to an IEEE 802.3 CSMA/CD 
 10Mbps Ethernet LAN via one of three network ports: 10BaseT, 10Base2, or AUI.

10BaseT and 10Base2 network ports provide 
 direct connection to 10BaseT or 10Base2 network without an external 
 transceiver.

Standard 15pin AUI network port allows choice 
 of 10Base5, 10Base2, 10BaseT, 10BaseF, or 10Broad36 medium with usersupplied 
 802.3compatible transceiver.

Firmware is preloaded for easy installation 
 and is maintained indefinitely; firmware is easily upgraded insystem from PC 
 attached to RS485 serial port.
TCP/IP communication services using SRTP.

Full MFC programming and configuration 
 services.

Comprehensive station management and 
 diagnostic tools.
